"""Fixed published-repository Git operations. Transported by the existing SSH runner.

Only operation-derived paths and configured remote URLs reach this private script.
No source checkout is named. No hooks, filters, recursive submodules or push.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import contextlib
import fcntl
import json
import os
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import sys

LOCK_FDS = []


def real(path):
    if not os.path.isdir(path) or os.path.realpath(path) != path:
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_DESTINATION_UNPROVEN")


@contextlib.contextmanager
def directory(path):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        yield fd
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def git(repo, *args, network=False, optional=False):
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
    env.update(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0", GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT="0", GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS="1",
               SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE="never", GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE="1")
    if not network:
        env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="/dev/null")
    result = subprocess.run(["git", "--no-optional-locks", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null",  # noqa: S603,S607
        "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", "-c", "gc.auto=0", "-c", "maintenance.auto=false",
        "-c", "protocol.ext.allow=never", "-c", "fetch.recurseSubmodules=false", "-C", repo, *args],
        capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=1800, pass_fds=tuple(LOCK_FDS))
    if result.returncode:
        if optional:
            return None
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_GIT_FAILED")
    return result.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="strict").strip()


def identity(req):
    clone = req["clone_path"]
    real(clone)
    common = clone + "/.git"
    real(common)
    for parent, dirs, files in os.walk(common, followlinks=False):
        for name in dirs + files:
            item = os.lstat(os.path.join(parent, name))
            if stat.S_ISLNK(item.st_mode) or (not stat.S_ISDIR(item.st_mode) and (
                    not stat.S_ISREG(item.st_mode) or item.st_nlink != 1)):
                raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_CLONE_TAMPERED")
    if any(os.path.lexists(common + "/" + n) for n in ("objects/info/alternates", "objects/info/http-alternates",
            "info/grafts", "shallow", "commondir")) or git(clone, "for-each-ref", "refs/replace"):
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_CLONE_TAMPERED")
    allowed = re.compile(r"(?:core\.(?:repositoryformatversion|filemode|bare|logallrefupdates|ignorecase|precomposeunicode)|batc\.[a-z-]+)")
    if any(not allowed.fullmatch(k) for k in git(clone, "config", "--local", "--name-only", "--list").splitlines()):
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_CLONE_TAMPERED")
    for key, value in req["markers"].items():
        if git(clone, "config", "--local", "--get-all", "batc." + key, optional=True) != value:
            raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_CLONE_NOT_OURS")
    if git(clone, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir") != common:
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_CLONE_NOT_OURS")


def pinned(req):
    clone, sha = req["clone_path"], req["source_sha"]
    ref = "refs/batc/published/" + req["operation_id"][3:]
    seen = git(clone, "rev-parse", "--verify", ref, optional=True)
    if seen is None:
        return False
    if seen != sha or git(clone, "cat-file", "-t", sha) != "commit":
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_PIN_MISMATCH")
    return True


def carrier(req):
    clone, path, branch = req["clone_path"], req["worktree_path"], req["branch"]
    if not os.path.lexists(path):
        return None
    real(path)
    if (git(path, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir") != clone + "/.git"
            or git(path, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD") != branch):
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_CARRIER_CHANGED")
    head = git(path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    if head != req["source_sha"] or git(path, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"):
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_CARRIER_CHANGED")
    return {"clone_path": clone, "worktree_path": path, "branch": branch, "head": head}


def fetch_source(req):
    clone = req["clone_path"]
    remote = git(clone, "ls-remote", "--refs", req["remote_url"], req["source_ref"], network=True)
    matches = [r.split("\t", 1)[0] for r in remote.splitlines() if r.endswith("\t" + req["source_ref"])]
    if matches != [req["source_sha"]]:
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_REF_CHANGED")
    git(clone, "fetch", "--no-tags", "--no-write-fetch-head", "--no-recurse-submodules",
        req["remote_url"], req["source_sha"], network=True)
    if git(clone, "cat-file", "-t", req["source_sha"]) != "commit":
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_COMMIT_UNPROVEN")


def execute(req, *, observe=lambda stage, req, value: value, fetch_source=fetch_source):
    root, clone, phase = req["managed_root"], req["clone_path"], req["phase"]
    real(root)
    if (os.path.dirname(clone) != root or not re.fullmatch(r"batc-published-[0-9a-f]{32}", os.path.basename(clone))
            or not re.fullmatch(r"op_[0-9a-f]{32}", req["operation_id"])
            or clone != root + "/batc-published-" + req["operation_id"][3:]
            or req["worktree_path"] != clone + "/.bat-worktrees/batc-published-" + req["operation_id"][3:15]
            or req["branch"] != "batc/published-" + req["operation_id"][3:15]
            or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", req["source_sha"])):
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_DESTINATION_UNPROVEN")
    # Lock an existing directory inode; no lock-file link or pathname replacement.
    with directory(root) as root_fd:
        fcntl.flock(root_fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        LOCK_FDS.append(root_fd)
        real(root)
        if os.stat(root) != os.fstat(root_fd):
            raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_DESTINATION_UNPROVEN")
        # Cleanup locks this same clone inode. Root lock serializes its first creation.
        exists = os.path.lexists(clone)
        observe("existing", req, exists)
        if exists:
            real(clone)
        if phase.startswith("read.") and not exists:
            return {"exists": False}
        if not exists:
            print(json.dumps({"locked": True}), flush=True)
            if json.loads(sys.stdin.readline() or "{}").get("proceed") is not True:
                raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_GATE_REQUIRED")
            os.mkdir(clone)
            git(clone, "init", "--quiet", "--template=")
            for key, value in req["markers"].items():
                git(clone, "config", "--local", "batc." + key, value)
        fd = os.open(clone, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
            LOCK_FDS.append(fd)
            identity(req)
            if os.stat(clone) != os.fstat(fd):
                raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_DESTINATION_UNPROVEN")
            if phase.startswith("read."):
                return observe("result", req, {"exists": True, "pinned": pinned(req), "carrier": carrier(req) if phase == "read.carrier" else None})
            if exists:
                print(json.dumps({"locked": True}), flush=True)
                if json.loads(sys.stdin.readline() or "{}").get("proceed") is not True:
                    raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_GATE_REQUIRED")
            if phase == "fetch":
                if not pinned(req):
                    fetch_source(req)
                    git(clone, "update-ref", "refs/batc/published/" + req["operation_id"][3:], req["source_sha"], "")
                return observe("result", req, {"clone_path": clone, "source_sha": req["source_sha"], "pinned": True})
            if phase != "prepare" or not pinned(req):
                raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_PIN_MISMATCH")
            observed = carrier(req)
            if observed:
                return observe("result", req, observed)
            parent = clone + "/.bat-worktrees"
            if os.path.lexists(parent):
                real(parent)
            else:
                os.mkdir(parent)
            # A leftover branch without a registered carrier is not proof of no effect.
            if git(clone, "show-ref", "--verify", "refs/heads/" + req["branch"], optional=True):
                raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_CARRIER_UNPROVEN")
            git(clone, "worktree", "add", "--quiet", "-b", req["branch"], req["worktree_path"], req["source_sha"])
            return observe("result", req, carrier(req))
        finally:
            LOCK_FDS.remove(fd)
            os.close(fd)


"""Private PM carrier extension, appended to repository_sync_host by the runner.

Git setup uses the shared identity/locking helpers. Only fixed service-generated
JSON draft paths may be created. A manifest outside the worktree records their
original digests; an arbitrary pre-existing file is never adopted or overwritten.
"""
import base64
import contextlib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import zlib
from contextlib import ExitStack

if __name__ != "__main__":
    from .repository_sync_host import LOCK_FDS, directory, execute, git, identity, pinned, real

_MANIFEST = "batc-pm-drafts.json"
_DRAFT = re.compile(r"docs/pm/drafts/pmr_[0-9a-f]{32}/(?:context|reply)\.json")


def pm_json(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()


def pm_directory(parent_fd, name, *, create=False):
    if create:
        try:
            os.mkdir(name, mode=0o700, dir_fd=parent_fd)
            os.fsync(parent_fd)
        except FileExistsError:
            pass
    try:
        fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent_fd)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        raise
    except OSError:
        raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_PATH_UNSAFE") from None
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(os.fstat(fd).st_mode):
        os.close(fd)
        raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_PATH_UNSAFE")
    return fd


@contextlib.contextmanager
def pm_parent(path, relative, *, create=False):
    if not _DRAFT.fullmatch(relative):
        raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_PATH_UNSAFE")
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        root = stack.enter_context(directory(path))
        fd = root
        for component in relative.split("/")[:-1]:
            child = pm_directory(fd, component, create=create)
            stack.callback(os.close, child)
            fd = child
        yield fd


def pm_read(fd, name, *, missing=False, maximum=512_000):
    try:
        source = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=fd)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        if missing:
            return None
        raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_MISSING") from None
    try:
        before = os.fstat(source)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_nlink != 1 or before.st_size > maximum:
            raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_PATH_UNSAFE")
        chunks = []
        remaining = maximum + 1
        while remaining:
            chunk = os.read(source, min(65536, remaining))
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
            remaining -= len(chunk)
        after = os.fstat(source)
        content = b"".join(chunks)
        if len(content) > maximum or (before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) != (
                after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns):
            raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED")
        return content
    finally:
        os.close(source)


def pm_manifest(req):
    with directory(req["clone_path"] + "/.git") as fd:
        data = pm_read(fd, _MANIFEST, missing=True, maximum=4_000_000)
    if data is None:
        return {}
    try:
        value = json.loads(data)
        if (value.get("schema") != "batc.pm.drafts.v1" or value.get("workspace_id") != req["pm_workspace_id"]
                or value.get("binding_digest") != req["binding_digest"] or not isinstance(value.get("files"), dict)):
            raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
        for path, record in value["files"].items():
            if (not _DRAFT.fullmatch(path) or not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record) != {"sha256", "size", "operation_id"}
                    or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", record["sha256"])
                    or type(record["size"]) is not int or not 0 < record["size"] <= 512_000
                    or not re.fullmatch(r"op_[0-9a-f]{32}", record["operation_id"])):
                raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
        return value["files"]
    except (TypeError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_MANIFEST_CHANGED") from None


def pm_write(fd, name, content, *, replace=False):
    # Fixed pending name is only touched when its original bytes match exactly.
    pending = ".batc-pm-" + hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() + ".pending"
    try:
        dest = os.open(pending, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600, dir_fd=fd)
    except FileExistsError:
        if pm_read(fd, pending, maximum=4_000_000) != content:
            raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_PENDING_CHANGED") from None
    else:
        try:
            with os.fdopen(dest, "wb", closefd=False) as stream:
                stream.write(content)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(dest)
        finally:
            os.close(dest)
    if replace:
        os.replace(pending, name, src_dir_fd=fd, dst_dir_fd=fd)
    else:
        # Exclusive final creation avoids replacing even a same-name foreign file.
        # If interrupted after linking, read-back remains conservative until the
        # original pending link is reconciled; it never rewrites the target.
        os.link(pending, name, src_dir_fd=fd, dst_dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)
        os.unlink(pending, dir_fd=fd)
    os.fsync(fd)


def pm_save_manifest(req, files):
    content = pm_json({"schema": "batc.pm.drafts.v1", "workspace_id": req["pm_workspace_id"],
                       "binding_digest": req["binding_digest"], "files": files})
    with directory(req["clone_path"] + "/.git") as fd:
        # Validate old inode before replacing this service-owned metadata file.
        pm_read(fd, _MANIFEST, missing=True, maximum=4_000_000)
        pm_write(fd, _MANIFEST, content, replace=True)


def pm_snapshot_bytes(req):
    snapshot = req["snapshot"]
    try:
        relative = snapshot["path"]
        content = base64.b64decode(snapshot["content"], validate=True)
        doc = json.loads(content)
        if (not _DRAFT.fullmatch(relative) or relative != "docs/pm/drafts/" + snapshot["run_id"] + "/" + snapshot["kind"] + ".json"
                or len(content) != snapshot["size"] or len(content) > 512_000
                or hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() != snapshot["sha256"]
                or doc.get("schema") != "batc.pm.draft.v1" or doc.get("status") != "draft"
                or any(doc.get(key) != snapshot[key] for key in ("run_id", "kind", "operation_id", "payload_digest"))
                or doc.get("workspace_id") != req["pm_workspace_id"] or doc.get("server_id") != req["server_id"]
                or doc.get("controller_id") != req["execution_authority"]["controller_id"]
                or any(doc.get(key) != req[key] for key in ("repository_id", "source_sha", "binding_digest"))
                or hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(doc["payload"], sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
                    != snapshot["payload_digest"]):
            raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_INVALID")
        return content
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_INVALID") from None


def pm_carrier(req, *, pending=None):
    path, clone = req["worktree_path"], req["clone_path"]
    if not os.path.lexists(path):
        return None
    real(path)
    with directory(path) as fd:
        pm_read(fd, ".git", maximum=4096)
    if (git(path, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir") != clone + "/.git"
            or git(path, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD") != req["branch"]
            or git(path, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != req["source_sha"]
            or git(path, "diff-index", "--raw", "HEAD", "--")):
        raise ValueError("PM_WORKTREE_CHANGED")
    files = pm_manifest(req)
    untracked = set(filter(None, git(path, "ls-files", "--others", "-z").split("\0")))
    if untracked - set(files):
        raise ValueError("PM_WORKTREE_UNREGISTERED_FILES")
    for relative, record in files.items():
        try:
            with pm_parent(path, relative) as fd:
                data = pm_read(fd, relative.rsplit("/", 1)[1], missing=relative == pending)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            if relative == pending:
                continue
            raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_MISSING") from None
        if data is None and relative == pending:
            continue
        if len(data) != record["size"] or hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != record["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED")
    return {"clone_path": clone, "worktree_path": path, "branch": req["branch"], "head": req["source_sha"]}


def pm_snapshot(req, *, write):
    content = pm_snapshot_bytes(req)
    item = req["snapshot"]
    relative = item["path"]
    files = pm_manifest(req)
    record = {key: item[key] for key in ("sha256", "size", "operation_id")}
    if relative in files and files[relative] != record:
        raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_CONFLICT")
    # A tracked path belongs to the fixed source revision, even if bytes match.
    if git(req["worktree_path"], "ls-files", "--", relative):
        raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_TRACKED_PATH")
    try:
        with pm_parent(req["worktree_path"], relative) as fd:
            existing = pm_read(fd, relative.rsplit("/", 1)[1], missing=True)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        existing = None
    if existing is not None:
        if relative not in files or existing != content:
            raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_CONFLICT")
    elif write:
        # Journal step already contains this immutable digest before the host
        # intent is recorded. Interrupted partial writes retain that original key.
        with pm_parent(req["worktree_path"], relative, create=True) as fd:
            files[relative] = record
            pm_save_manifest(req, files)
            pm_write(fd, relative.rsplit("/", 1)[1], content)
    else:
        return {"snapshot": None}
    result = {key: item[key] for key in ("path", "kind", "run_id", "operation_id", "sha256", "size", "payload_digest")}
    result.update(worktree_path=req["worktree_path"], status="draft")
    return result if write else {"snapshot": result}


def pm_base_execute(req):
    before = list(LOCK_FDS)
    try:
        return execute(req)
    finally:
        LOCK_FDS[:] = before


def pm_execute(req):
    phase = req["phase"]
    if phase in {"fetch", "prepare", "read.fetch"}:
        return pm_base_execute(req)
    if phase not in {"read.pm-carrier", "read.pm-snapshot", "pm-snapshot"}:
        raise ValueError("PM_HOST_PHASE_INVALID")
    root, clone = req["managed_root"], req["clone_path"]
    # Reuse the original helper's strict operation-derived path validation.
    state = pm_base_execute({**req, "phase": "read.fetch"})
    if not state.get("exists"):
        return {"exists": False, "carrier": None, "snapshot": None}
    with directory(root) as root_fd, directory(clone) as clone_fd:
        fcntl.flock(root_fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        fcntl.flock(clone_fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        LOCK_FDS.extend((root_fd, clone_fd))
        try:
            real(root)
            real(clone)
            if os.stat(root) != os.fstat(root_fd) or os.stat(clone) != os.fstat(clone_fd):
                raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_DESTINATION_UNPROVEN")
            identity(req)
            if not pinned(req):
                raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_PIN_MISMATCH")
            pending = req["snapshot"]["path"] if "snapshot" in req else None
            carrier_result = pm_carrier(req, pending=pending)
            if phase == "read.pm-carrier":
                return {"exists": True, "carrier": carrier_result}
            if carrier_result is None:
                raise ValueError("PM_WORKTREE_MISSING")
            if phase == "pm-snapshot":
                print(json.dumps({"locked": True}), flush=True)
                if json.loads(sys.stdin.readline() or "{}").get("proceed") is not True:
                    raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_GATE_REQUIRED")
                # Final local checks after the central writer/member check.
                identity(req)
                pm_carrier(req, pending=pending)
            return pm_snapshot(req, write=phase == "pm-snapshot")
        finally:
            LOCK_FDS.remove(clone_fd)
            LOCK_FDS.remove(root_fd)


"""Portable fixed revision paths shared with the owned-host Git script."""
import re


def rev_paths(data):
    if data.get("artifact_kind") == "pm-spec":
        if (not re.fullmatch(r"pmsp_[0-9a-f]{32}", data["revision_id"])
                or not re.fullmatch(r"pm-[0-9a-f]{32}", data["change_id"])
                or not re.fullmatch(r"pmwp_[0-9a-f]{32}", data["package_id"])):
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INVALID")
        prefix = "openspec/changes/" + data["change_id"] + "/revisions/" + data["package_id"] + "/"
        return {prefix + name for name in ("package.json", "proposal.md", "requirements.md", "design.md", "tasks.md", "manifest.json")} | {
            "docs/pm/specs/" + data["change_id"] + "/revisions/" + data["package_id"] + ".json"}
    if "artifact_kind" in data or not re.fullmatch(r"pmrev_[0-9a-f]{32}", data["revision_id"]):
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INVALID")
    return {"docs/pm/revisions/" + data["revision_id"] + "/plan." + ext for ext in ("md", "json")}

"""Deterministic, scoped PM revision Git transaction on the original owned carrier.

Appended after the published repository and PM draft helpers by the existing SSH
runner. The Git fact is not an adopted-plan decision. No source checkout or remote
push is involved, and only this clone's dedicated worktree/index is changed.
"""
import base64
import contextlib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import zlib
from contextlib import ExitStack

if __name__ != "__main__":
    from .pm_revision_paths import rev_paths
    from .pm_worktree_host import pm_carrier as _base_carrier
    from .pm_worktree_host import (
        pm_directory,
        pm_execute,
        pm_manifest,
        pm_parent,
        pm_read,
        pm_write,
    )
    from .repository_sync_host import LOCK_FDS, directory, git, identity, pinned, real
else:
    _base_carrier = globals()["pm_carrier"]

_REVISIONS = "batc-pm-revisions.json"
_REV_PATH = re.compile(r"(?:docs/pm/revisions/pmrev_[0-9a-f]{32}/plan\.(?:json|md)|"
    r"openspec/changes/pm-[0-9a-f]{32}/revisions/pmwp_[0-9a-f]{32}/(?:package\.json|proposal\.md|requirements\.md|design\.md|tasks\.md|manifest\.json)|"
    r"docs/pm/specs/pm-[0-9a-f]{32}/revisions/pmwp_[0-9a-f]{32}\.json)")


def rev_json(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode()


def rev_binding(req):
    return hashlib.sha256(rev_json({"server_id": req["server_id"], "workspace_id": req["pm_workspace_id"],
        "bootstrap_id": req["operation_id"], "binding_digest": req["binding_digest"]})).hexdigest()


def rev_git(path, *args, data=None):
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("GIT_")}
    env.update(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0", GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT="0", GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS="1",
               GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="/dev/null", GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE="1")
    result = subprocess.run(["git", "--no-optional-locks", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null",  # noqa: S603,S607
        "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", "-c", "gc.auto=0", "-c", "maintenance.auto=false",
        "-c", "protocol.ext.allow=never", "-c", "fetch.recurseSubmodules=false", "-C", path, *args],
        input=data, capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=1800, pass_fds=tuple(LOCK_FDS))
    if result.returncode:
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_GIT_FAILED")
    return result.stdout


def rev_load(req):
    with directory(req["clone_path"] + "/.git") as fd:
        raw = pm_read(fd, _REVISIONS, missing=True, maximum=4_000_000)
    if raw is None:
        return []
    try:
        value = json.loads(raw)
        if value["schema"] != "batc.pm.revisions.v1" or value["binding_id"] != rev_binding(req):
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
        rows = value["records"]
        if not isinstance(rows, list):
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
        parent, operations, revisions = req["source_sha"], set(), set()
        for index, row in enumerate(rows):
            receipt = row["receipt"]
            if (row["parent"] != parent or row["state"] not in {"prepared", "complete"}
                    or row["state"] == "prepared" and index != len(rows) - 1
                    or receipt["binding_id"] != rev_binding(req) or receipt["workspace_id"] != req["pm_workspace_id"]
                    or not re.fullmatch(r"op_[0-9a-f]{32}", receipt["operation_id"])
                    or receipt["operation_id"] in operations or receipt["revision_id"] in revisions
                    or any(not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", receipt[key]) for key in ("commit_sha", "tree_sha"))
                    or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", row["index_before"])
                    or row["state"] == "complete" and not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", row["index_after"])):
                raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
            expected_paths = rev_paths(receipt)
            if set(receipt["file_digests"]) != expected_paths:
                raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
            operations.add(receipt["operation_id"])
            revisions.add(receipt["revision_id"])
            parent = receipt["commit_sha"]
        return rows
    except (KeyError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_MANIFEST_CHANGED") from None


def rev_save(req, rows):
    raw = rev_json({"schema": "batc.pm.revisions.v1", "binding_id": rev_binding(req), "records": rows}) + b"\n"
    if len(raw) > 4_000_000:
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_MANIFEST_LIMIT")
    with directory(req["clone_path"] + "/.git") as fd:
        pm_read(fd, _REVISIONS, missing=True, maximum=4_000_000)
        pm_write(fd, _REVISIONS, raw, replace=True)


def rev_object(kind, data):
    return hashlib.sha1(kind.encode() + b" " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()  # noqa: S324 - Git SHA-1 object identity


def rev_commit_bytes(record):
    receipt = record["receipt"]
    author = b"PM Workspace <pm@example.invalid> " + str(record["timestamp"]).encode() + b" +0000"
    return (b"tree " + receipt["tree_sha"].encode() + b"\nparent " + record["parent"].encode()
            + b"\nauthor " + author + b"\ncommitter " + author + b"\n\nPM revision "
            + receipt["revision_id"].encode() + b"\n\nBATC-Operation: " + receipt["operation_id"].encode() + b"\n")


def rev_ref(record):
    return "refs/batc/pm-revisions/" + record["receipt"]["operation_id"][3:]


def rev_verify(req, record):
    receipt = record["receipt"]
    clone = req["clone_path"]
    if git(clone, "rev-parse", "--verify", rev_ref(record), optional=True) != receipt["commit_sha"]:
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_REF_CHANGED")
    if rev_git(clone, "cat-file", "commit", receipt["commit_sha"]) != rev_commit_bytes(record):
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_COMMIT_CHANGED")
    paths = rev_git(clone, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", "-z", record["parent"], receipt["commit_sha"])
    if set(paths.decode().strip("\0").split("\0")) != set(receipt["file_digests"]):
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_SCOPE_CHANGED")
    for path, digest in receipt["file_digests"].items():
        if hashlib.sha256(rev_git(clone, "cat-file", "blob", receipt["commit_sha"] + ":" + path)).hexdigest() != digest:
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_FILES_CHANGED")
    if hashlib.sha256(rev_json(receipt["file_digests"])).hexdigest() != receipt["document_digest"]:
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_FILES_CHANGED")


def rev_index(req):
    path = git(req["worktree_path"], "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-path", "index")
    common = req["clone_path"] + "/.git/worktrees/"
    if not path.startswith(common) or os.path.realpath(path) != path:
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INDEX_CHANGED")
    with directory(os.path.dirname(path)) as fd:
        value = pm_read(fd, "index", maximum=64_000_000)
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def rev_head(req, *, pending=False):
    rows = rev_load(req)
    head = req["source_sha"]
    for row in rows:
        if row["state"] == "prepared":
            if not pending:
                raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_PENDING")
            break
        rev_verify(req, row)
        head = row["receipt"]["commit_sha"]
    return head, rows


def pm_carrier(req, *, pending=None):
    head, rows = rev_head(req, pending=True)
    if rows and rows[-1]["state"] == "prepared":
        record = rows[-1]
        if record["receipt"]["operation_id"] != req.get("active_operation_id"):
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_PENDING")
        current = rev_pending_guard(req, record,
            {path: {"sha256": digest} for path, digest in record["receipt"]["file_digests"].items()})
        return {"clone_path": req["clone_path"], "worktree_path": req["worktree_path"], "branch": req["branch"], "head": current}
    observed = _base_carrier({**req, "source_sha": head}, pending=pending)
    if observed and rows and rev_index(req) != rows[-1]["index_after"]:
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INDEX_CHANGED")
    return observed


@contextlib.contextmanager
def rev_parent(path, relative, *, create=False):
    if not _REV_PATH.fullmatch(relative):
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_PATH_INVALID")
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        fd = stack.enter_context(directory(path))
        for component in relative.split("/")[:-1]:
            fd = pm_directory(fd, component, create=create)
            stack.callback(os.close, fd)
        yield fd


def rev_request(req):
    data = req["revision"]
    try:
        if (data["workspace_id"] != req["pm_workspace_id"] or data["binding_id"] != rev_binding(req)
                or not re.fullmatch(r"op_[0-9a-f]{32}", data["operation_id"])
                or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", data["expected_parent"])
                or type(data["timestamp"]) is not int or not 0 < data["timestamp"] < 32_503_680_000
                or set(data["files"]) != rev_paths(data)):
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INVALID")
        files = {path: content.encode() for path, content in data["files"].items()}
        if (sum(map(len, files.values())) > 512_000
                or {path: hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() for path, content in files.items()} != data["file_digests"]
                or hashlib.sha256(rev_json(data["file_digests"])).hexdigest() != data["document_digest"]):
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INVALID")
        return data, files
    except (KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError, UnicodeEncodeError):
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INVALID") from None


def rev_tree(req, parent, files):
    """Read only existing ancestor trees; construct Git objects without an index."""
    objects = []
    trie = {}
    for path, data in files.items():
        node = trie
        parts = path.split("/")
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            node = node.setdefault(part.encode(), {})
        node[parts[-1].encode()] = data
    def tree(sha, additions):
        entries = {}
        if sha:
            raw = rev_git(req["clone_path"], "cat-file", "tree", sha)
            offset = 0
            while offset < len(raw):
                zero = raw.index(b"\0", offset)
                mode, name = raw[offset:zero].split(b" ", 1)
                entries[name] = (mode, raw[zero + 1:zero + 21].hex())
                offset = zero + 21
        for name, item in additions.items():
            previous = entries.get(name)
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                if previous and previous[0] != b"40000":
                    raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_PATH_INVALID")
                entries[name] = (b"40000", tree(previous[1] if previous else None, item))
            else:
                if previous:
                    raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_PATH_EXISTS")
                sha = rev_object("blob", item)
                objects.append(("blob", sha, item))
                entries[name] = (b"100644", sha)
        data = b"".join(mode + b" " + name + b"\0" + bytes.fromhex(sha) for name, (mode, sha) in
                        sorted(entries.items(), key=lambda pair: pair[0] + (b"/" if pair[1][0] == b"40000" else b"")))
        sha = rev_object("tree", data)
        objects.append(("tree", sha, data))
        return sha
    parent_tree = git(req["clone_path"], "rev-parse", parent + "^{tree}")
    return tree(parent_tree, trie), objects


def rev_pending_guard(req, record, files):
    """Prove that an interrupted original transaction can still be finished."""
    path, receipt = req["worktree_path"], record["receipt"]
    real(path)
    if git(path, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD") != req["branch"]:
        raise ValueError("PM_WORKTREE_CHANGED")
    current = git(path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    if current not in {record["parent"], receipt["commit_sha"]}:
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_PARENT_CHANGED")
    if git(req["clone_path"], "rev-parse", "--verify", rev_ref(record), optional=True) not in {None, receipt["commit_sha"]}:
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_REF_CHANGED")
    # Reject index flags that would hide worktree changes from normal Git diff.
    flags = rev_git(path, "ls-files", "-v", "-z").split(b"\0")
    if any(line and (line[:1].islower() or line[:1] == b"S") for line in flags):
        raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INDEX_CHANGED")
    index = rev_index(req)
    if index != record["index_before"]:
        if current != receipt["commit_sha"] or rev_git(path, "diff-index", "--cached", "--raw", current, "--"):
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INDEX_CHANGED")
    for args in (("diff-index", "--name-only", "-z", record["parent"], "--"), ("diff-files", "--name-only", "-z", "--")):
        changed = set(filter(None, rev_git(path, *args).decode().split("\0")))
        if changed - set(files):
            raise ValueError("PM_WORKTREE_CHANGED")
    drafts = pm_manifest(req)
    for relative, original in drafts.items():
        with pm_parent(path, relative) as fd:
            saved = pm_read(fd, relative.rsplit("/", 1)[1])
        if len(saved) != original["size"] or hashlib.sha256(saved).hexdigest() != original["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("PM_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED")
    unknown = set(filter(None, rev_git(path, "ls-files", "--others", "-z").decode().split("\0")))
    if unknown - set(drafts) - set(files):
        raise ValueError("PM_WORKTREE_UNREGISTERED_FILES")
    for relative, data in files.items():
        try:
            with rev_parent(path, relative) as fd:
                existing = pm_read(fd, relative.rsplit("/", 1)[1], missing=True)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            existing = None
        expected_digest = data["sha256"] if isinstance(data, dict) else hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        if existing is not None and hashlib.sha256(existing).hexdigest() != expected_digest:
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_FILES_CHANGED")
    return current


def rev_transaction(req, *, write):
    data, files = rev_request(req)
    head, rows = rev_head(req, pending=True)
    existing = next((row for row in rows if row["receipt"]["operation_id"] == data["operation_id"]), None)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(rev_json(data)).hexdigest()
    if existing:
        if existing["request_digest"] != digest:
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INTENT_CHANGED")
        if existing["state"] == "complete":
            rev_verify(req, existing)
            pm_carrier(req)
            return existing["receipt"] if write else {"receipt": existing["receipt"]}
    else:
        if rows and rows[-1]["state"] != "complete":
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_PENDING")
        if head != data["expected_parent"]:
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_PARENT_CHANGED")
        pm_carrier(req)
    tree, objects = rev_tree(req, data["expected_parent"], files)
    receipt = {key: data[key] for key in ("workspace_id", "revision_id", "operation_id", "document_digest", "file_digests", "binding_id")}
    if data.get("artifact_kind") == "pm-spec":
        receipt.update({key: data[key] for key in ("artifact_kind", "change_id", "package_id")})
    receipt.update(tree_sha=tree, status="verified")
    proposed = {"receipt": receipt, "parent": data["expected_parent"], "timestamp": data["timestamp"],
                "state": "prepared", "request_digest": digest, "index_before": rev_index(req)}
    commit = rev_commit_bytes(proposed)
    receipt["commit_sha"] = rev_object("commit", commit)
    objects.append(("commit", receipt["commit_sha"], commit))
    if existing:
        if existing["receipt"] != receipt:
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_INTENT_CHANGED")
        proposed = existing
    rev_pending_guard(req, proposed, files)
    if not write:
        # No branch/index effect can be replayed without these exact old/own
        # resource facts; the mutation path checks them again under its gate.
        return {"receipt": None, "resume_safe": True, "effect_started": existing is not None}
    print(json.dumps({"locked": True}), flush=True)
    if json.loads(sys.stdin.readline() or "{}").get("proceed") is not True:
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_GATE_REQUIRED")
    identity(req)
    rev_pending_guard(req, proposed, files)
    if not existing:
        rows.append(proposed)
        rev_save(req, rows)
    for kind, sha, content in objects:
        actual = rev_git(req["clone_path"], "hash-object", "-w", "-t", kind, "--stdin", data=content).decode().strip()
        if actual != sha:
            raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_OBJECT_CHANGED")
    for relative, content in files.items():
        with rev_parent(req["worktree_path"], relative, create=True) as fd:
            existing_bytes = pm_read(fd, relative.rsplit("/", 1)[1], missing=True)
            if existing_bytes is None:
                pm_write(fd, relative.rsplit("/", 1)[1], content)
            elif existing_bytes != content:
                raise ValueError("PM_REVISION_FILES_CHANGED")
    if git(req["clone_path"], "rev-parse", "--verify", rev_ref(proposed), optional=True) is None:
        git(req["clone_path"], "update-ref", rev_ref(proposed), receipt["commit_sha"], "")
    current = rev_pending_guard(req, proposed, files)
    if current == proposed["parent"]:
        git(req["clone_path"], "update-ref", "refs/heads/" + req["branch"], receipt["commit_sha"], proposed["parent"])
    # Only this proven PM-owned index is synchronized; objects were built without
    # using it, so no staged draft or unrelated path can enter the commit.
    rev_pending_guard(req, proposed, files)
    git(req["worktree_path"], "read-tree", "--reset", receipt["commit_sha"])
    git(req["worktree_path"], "update-index", "--refresh")
    proposed["index_after"] = rev_index(req)
    proposed["state"] = "complete"
    rev_verify(req, proposed)
    rev_save(req, rows)
    pm_carrier(req)
    return receipt


def rev_execute(req):
    if req["phase"] not in {"pm-revision", "read.pm-revision"}:
        return pm_execute(req)
    root, clone = req["managed_root"], req["clone_path"]
    real(root)
    real(clone)
    if clone != root + "/batc-published-" + req["operation_id"][3:]:
        raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_DESTINATION_UNPROVEN")
    with directory(root) as root_fd, directory(clone) as clone_fd:
        fcntl.flock(root_fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        fcntl.flock(clone_fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        LOCK_FDS.extend((root_fd, clone_fd))
        try:
            if os.stat(root) != os.fstat(root_fd) or os.stat(clone) != os.fstat(clone_fd):
                raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_DESTINATION_UNPROVEN")
            identity(req)
            if not pinned(req):
                raise ValueError("REPOSITORY_PIN_MISMATCH")
            return rev_transaction(req, write=req["phase"] == "pm-revision")
        finally:
            LOCK_FDS.remove(clone_fd)
            LOCK_FDS.remove(root_fd)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        request = json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1])))
        print(json.dumps({"result": rev_execute(request)}), flush=True)
    except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        exc = sys.exc_info()[1]
        code = str(exc) if str(exc).startswith(("REPOSITORY_", "PM_")) else "PM_HOST_UNCERTAIN"
        print(json.dumps({"error": code}), flush=True)
